summary: Validated all 3 new enhancements: (1) Map preview thumbnail in PDF, (2) Auto-translate ES→EN at submit, (3) Native browser spell check via document.documentElement.lang. Backend pytest 59/59 PASS (5 new translate tests + 54 carry-over from iter 7). /api/translate live LLM round-trip confirmed: POST {from_lang:es,to_lang:en,strings:{project_name:'Proyecto Prueba',location:'Calle Principal 5, Tampa FL',prepared_by:'Juan García',notes:'Hubo un derrame de aceite en la zanja durante la mañana'}} → English back: project_name='Test Project', location='Main Street 5, Tampa FL', prepared_by='Juan García' (proper noun preserved), notes='There was an oil spill in the trench during the morning'. Empty-strings short-circuit returns {strings:{}}; same-lang short-circuit returns input unchanged — both 200. Frontend live-probed on the public preview URL: /daily/new lang toggle now flips document.documentElement.lang ES↔EN as designed (browser spell-check follows that locale). NO input[type=text] or textarea on /daily/new, /inspect/new, /meetings/new, /jha/new, /incidents/new has spellcheck=false set anywhere — so default (true) browser spell check is active in EN mode and Spanish dictionary picks up after ES toggle. MapThumbnail confirmed on all 5 view pages (/daily/:id, /inspect/:id, /meetings/:id, /jha/:id, /incidents/:id) when record has gps_lat+gps_lng: data-testid='map-thumbnail' wrapper present in DOM with classes 'hidden print:block mt-2' (correct: invisible on screen, prints in PDF), and exactly 6 child tags pointing to tile.openstreetmap.org for the 3×2 zoom-16 grid — verified across all 5 module view pages. Regression: 18 spec testids on /daily/new all present, 'Project Name is required' empty-submit toast still fires, Hub still shows 5 tiles in spec order [hub-tile-daily, hub-tile-inspections, hub-tile-meetings, hub-tile-jha, hub-tile-incidents], all 4 other /new routes still load with job-picker-trigger present. Submit handlers in all 5 New*.jsx pages correctly call toast.info('Translating to English…') and translateUserInput(payload,'es') only when lang==='es' (verified via grep). Zero JS console errors across all probed pages.
action_items: [Optional carry-over from iter 6/7] /app/backend/server.py is now ~735 lines (added /api/translate route at lines 640-735). File size is past the 700-line guideline — worth splitting into routers/{inspections,meetings,jhas,incidents,daily_reports,translate}.py with shared models module.
critical_code_review_comments: translateOnSubmit.js: Walker correctly skips data: URLs, ISO dates/times, pure numerics, yes/no values, and key-blacklist (signature|photo|id|created_at|gps_|*_lat|*_lng|score|status|*_count|*_date|*_time|*_number|severity|incident_type|operation|topic_category). Path-based round-trip preserves payload shape, deep-clones before mutation. Try/catch swallows all errors and returns original payload — submit is never blocked. Clean.

MapThumbnail.jsx (keyless OSM static map): Uses public tile.openstreetmap.org tiles in a 3×2 zoom-16 grid centered on the record's GPS. Default class 'hidden print:block' = display:none on screen, visible only in print preview — exactly what the PDF requires. Has data-testid='map-thumbnail' for testing. Independently rendered on all 5 View pages.

i18n.js setLang now syncs document.documentElement.lang — verified flipping live ('en'→'es'→'en') on /daily/new. This is what enables the browser to swap between English and Spanish spell-check dictionaries.

All 5 New*.jsx submit handlers now run a translate-pass when lang==='es' before POST, with a toast.info('Translating to English…') visual cue. translateUserInput is dynamically imported in 4 of 5 pages (NewIncident, NewInspection, NewJha, NewMeeting) and statically imported in NewDailyReport — both work, but the inconsistency is cosmetic.

Backend /api/translate endpoint: Uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with Claude Haiku 4.5. Empty-strings and same-lang short-circuits both return immediately with no LLM call (cost-saving + fast). On any LLM failure (budget/network) it gracefully falls back to returning original strings — never 5xx — so frontend submit never breaks.

Spellcheck audit: 0 inputs/textareas have spellcheck='false' set across all 5 new-form pages. Default behavior (true) + dynamic document.documentElement.lang gives correct EN/ES dictionary per session.

success_rate.backend: 100% (59/59 pytest, including 5 new translate tests + 54 carry-over)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on probed surfaces: lang toggle (en↔es flips document.documentElement.lang), spell-check audit (0 disabled), MapThumbnail testid + 6 OSM tiles + correct print-only classes on all 5 View pages, Hub 5 tiles in spec order, all 4 regression /new routes load with JobPicker, /daily/new 18 testids present, empty-submit toast fires, 0 console errors.

test_credentials: N/A — no auth, public preview. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (sk-emergent-162DfE3BbA581E2093) is in /app/backend/.env and is exercised live by 2 of 5 translate tests + the curl round-trip.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED 5 records (one per module) with gps_lat=27.9506, gps_lng=-82.4572 to probe MapThumbnail rendering on each View page. All 5 cleaned up via DELETE 200 — no residual TEST_MAP_* data left in DB. test_translate.py 5 tests are stateless (no DB rows). test_daily_reports.py creates 2 TEST_DR_* rows that auto-clean per fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (~7s, 59/59). New testid: data-testid='map-thumbnail' on all 5 View pages — ALWAYS rendered when record has gps_lat+gps_lng but ALWAYS display:none on screen (class='hidden print:block mt-2'); test by DOM presence + child count, not visibility. Translate endpoint: POST /api/translate {from_lang, to_lang, strings:{}} → 200 {strings:{...same keys...}}. Empty-dict and same-lang short-circuit fast. To exercise translate-on-submit through the full UI, you'd need to: navigate to /daily/new (or any /new), click [data-testid='lang-es'], pick a job, fill location/prepared_by/notes in Spanish, draw on prepared-by-sig-canvas, upload 6 photos via PhotoUpload, click submit-bottom-btn — toast.info('Translating to English…') will fire then 'Daily report saved' on success, and GET /api/daily-reports/{id} should return English text in freeform fields. Faster path: direct /api/translate POST as proven via curl. The translate helper at /app/frontend/src/lib/translateOnSubmit.js is dependency-free except for /lib/api so you can also unit-test it from a script tag if needed.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified this iteration. All 3 enhancements are shipped, verified live, and matching the review-request spec across all 9 acceptance items: (1) backend /api/translate contract+live ✓, (2) backend regression on 4 prior modules ✓, (3) document.documentElement.lang flips on EN/ES toggle ✓, (4) no spellcheck=false on form inputs/textareas ✓, (5) MapThumbnail with data-testid + 6 OSM tiles + print-only classes on all 5 View pages ✓, (6) translate-on-submit handlers wired in all 5 New*.jsx pages ✓, (7) /daily/new 18 regression testids ✓, (8) Hub 5 tiles in spec order + 4 other /new routes load with JobPicker ✓, (9) 'Project Name is required' empty-submit toast still fires ✓, with zero console errors anywhere.
